Context: 10. Partial Withdrawal

## 10. Partial Withdrawal  
Following are the conditions of Partial Withdrawal:  
- (a)
- Subscriber should be in NPS system for 3 years.
- Withdrawal amount will not exceed 25% of the contributions
- (b) made by the Subscriber.
- (c)
- Withdrawal is allowed only against the specified' reasons
- (i)
- (ii)
- Higher education of children.
- Marriage of children.
